notation.closed: All listed fields required; exact field sets; null only where Nullable. Integers exclude booleans. Tagged bodies use exactly the named kind's fields. No free extension map.
notation.encoding: Inherit design05 strict canonical UTF-8 JSON, depth32 and no floats/duplicate keys/BOM. Binary capture uses lowercase even-length hex or ObjectRef to bounded retained raw bytes.
notation.imports: Import design05 types unchanged unless explicitly listed in required_contract_deltas. Import source04 fact/completion/scoring types by pinned source; no authenticity inferred from shape.
notation.reference: ObjectRef always hashes the actual retained object bytes; no executable or model binary is placed in the bounded evidence object store.
notation.type_strings: Existing design05 type grammar plus union tags and Nullable. This descriptive interface is not an executable validator.
notation.bounds: Per method record <=1MiB, each retained raw object <=4MiB, total method raw <=64MiB. Entire RPC signature frame <=4MiB; advance attachments <=64KiB each; checkpoint/attestation text <=8KiB each; history <=23. Reject overflow. Smaller bounds never renew clocks.

required_contract_deltas.issue: ProcessIdentity.exe_object_ref is a <=4MiB ObjectRef, but current semantics compare its hash/size directly with the executable binary and recursively resolve it as evidence. Large selected executables cannot use that representation.

required_behavior: No object in this candidate is an appointment, receipt, key, private case or runtime observation.
Unknown/missing operation, raw bytes, decoder, root, signer or type is unavailable/rejected; no fixture fallback.

Capture operation indices are allocated synchronously by the one pinned reporting process at the actual call boundary; no post-hoc numeric reconstruction. Indices strictly increase within the batch; exchange close < verdict < exposure is enforced.
Raw reports are trusted bootstrap/controller statements, not kernel tracing or compromised-controller proof.
Expected descriptor/policy selections come from pinned launch rules and independently retained parent-spawn operations, never the inspected child's claimed inventory.
Checkpoint response ABSENT is only an authenticated initial state observation; only separately authorized atomic reservation can consume an unused key.
Exactly the retained transition request bytes may be recovered after uncertainty; no new transition ID/time/output signature. Fresh read nonce does not create new mutation authority.
Full R6 private mapping, original denominators, two probes plus30 mandatory calls and zero retries/U1 remain unchanged.

Imported parent types remain exact in the preserved baseline. A reviewed method-contract successor must transitively replace ProcessIdentity.exe_object_ref with exe_asset and re-pin all dependent schemas, payloads, decoder and source argument. Old /2 meanings are never silently reinterpreted.

The service validates the initial authorization under the external authorizer key, binds issuer/budget/key/context/outer window, and atomically spends it with the original setup key. The unsigned budget start must be a current paired observation inside that authorization and the original window; no new start is derived after uncertainty.
Record-size and 23-transition bounds are enforced before mutation. A response unable to return complete required history is UNAVAILABLE, never a truncated accepted proof.

RPC domain strings contain a single trailing LF byte, not two literal backslash/n bytes. Verify the externally selected domain concatenated with canonical body bytes; body fields never select their own verification key or domain.

Checkpoint ABSENT = generation0/zero head/no history/no certificate from initialized authenticated store. Positive states require complete consecutive per-key history and matching head. REJECTED/UNAVAILABLE expose no usable checkpoint. Fresh response binds exact request hash/nonce, store, authority-view hash and clock domain.

Candidate02 protected refs/completion/controller consumption records are normative companions. Earlier issuer reads cannot substitute for the controller's fresh nonce/request bound read immediately before its one-use consumption commit.

Every raw byte reference in ProcRead, NamespaceRead, FdObservation, SendCall, RecvCall and native argument observations resolves a RAW_BLOB_MANIFEST authenticated in EventInputs; that manifest in turn binds NATIVE_CAPTURE_BYTES. Empty raw data is explicitly zero bytes/hash-of-empty/null leaf, not a missing invented ObjectRef.

Candidate03 fixes only the role-release wrapper and its exact validation/publisher route, the explicit inherited RECORDS path, canonical example Utc and removal of the unused V1 registry domain. Candidate02's four repairs remain required.

RawBlobManifest (RAW_BLOB_MANIFEST) binds raw ObjectRef, origin, capture subject, clock interval and budget; native bytes need no JSON rewrite. CaptureBatch references the exact manifest and raw object.

Authenticates exact native byte hash/length and origin; empty bytes require null blob_ref and SHA256(empty). Nonempty bytes require exact NATIVE_CAPTURE_BYTES reference. Native bytes are not parsed as JSON.

event_input_rules: Event has input_bundle_ref:AUTHENTICATED_EVENT_INPUTS and input_bundle_envelope_ref:SIGNED_ENVELOPE. Both are signed/bound before event ACK; Event itself retains its own method-witness signature. EventInputs repeats binding/budget/stream/record/slot/kind, never the event hash, avoiding a digest cycle.

Event.raw_refs is exactly the deduplicated input bundle, its envelope, and all normalized object refs named by DecodeBinding, capped at64. The input bundle transitively and explicitly names every authenticated capture/decode/selection/spawn/blob-manifest object and envelope. Resolve/re-pin the complete typed acyclic reference graph under total limits; never omit a nested dependency. Larger native byte blobs remain authenticated leaves, not direct event fields.

Each DecodeBinding.capture_refs/capture_envelope_refs is an ordered exact pairing within EventInputs.capture_objects. Each normalized_ref has the declared normalized_artifact_kind and must equal the consumer decoder result under exact selected input/code/format pins. RawBlobManifest references authenticate retained native bytes; bare raw refs alone cannot confer observation authority.

RuntimeSelectionBinding.selection_ref must equal EventInputs.selected_values.object_ref; slot/subject/decoder/source references equal the externally selected CoveragePlan and authenticated stage inputs. Expected policy never derives from observed enforcement.

RUNNER_INSTALL and MODEL_INSTALL require exactly one SpawnSelection object in EventInputs, with SPAWN operation in its referenced authenticated capture and an index selecting that operation. Role/parent/child/executable/policy/descriptors match, result must be SPAWNED_AND_PAUSED, returned_pid equals paused_child.pid. Other slots set spawn_selection null and may reference prior accepted spawn evidence through selected_source_refs.

Event normalized raw kinds required by design05 payload checks remain present exactly as needed; the added container kinds do not replace PROC_IDENTITY, DESCRIPTOR_INVENTORY, INSTALL_ARGUMENTS or any substantive predicate.

All six structured artifact classes and RawBlobManifest use the witness-v3 purpose with exact allowed format/kind checks. Consumer redoes decode/selection checks; no additional signer role or independent-kernel-trace claim is created.
